item.title: Wayne Hunt Named Kentucky Friend Of 4-H
item.description: Kentucky 4-H is honoring a local ag leader for his transformative support of agricultural youth programs. Wayne Hunt of H&R Agri-Power received the “Friend of Kentucky 4-H” and “Partners in Progress” awards at the Kentucky Volunteer Forum.
